# Nova navigation interaction fixture

导航交互样例，合成权限菜单，无业务后端。
Navigation interaction sample: synthetic permission menu, no business backend.

Open the zh-hans/en dark, light, or auto HTML variants through an ordinary static HTTP server. This is **not** a running Django admin service. It is distinct from the inert full-page admin snapshot export. No deployment or public upload is performed by the generator.

Generated by Django 6.1.1 TestClient using the current theme's real navigation templates and permission-filtered AdminSite menus. The database is explicitly :memory:, the fixture account has an unusable password, and only the resulting navigation/toggle elements survive extraction. All model/home/add links point to one local explanatory anchor. The exported preference scope is a deterministic public fixture namespace, not an account/session value.

The only executable assets are unchanged installed Django 6.1.1 nav_sidebar.js and the current Nova navigation.js. They provide desktop sidebar visibility, a mobile Navigation disclosure, group/app/model search, native details/summary collapse, bounded site/user-scoped preference behavior (using the fixture scope here), and Escape clearing. Mobile Escape clears a search first, then closes the menu and returns focus to Navigation. Without JavaScript the mobile menu remains visible. Mobile disclosure never changes the stored desktop sidebar preference. Groups and applications initially stay collapsed even on deep links; only summary activations are persisted, and search expansion is temporary. The filter query uses sessionStorage; explicit collapse choices use version2 localStorage. Failed initial reads preserve unknown saved navigation, favorites and query values until a fresh load. Browser storage blocking does not disable Nova's filter/collapse or mobile disclosure, but the upstream desktop sidebar toggle itself has unguarded storage access. No application API, form, login, CSRF value, auth session field, iframe, inline script or remote asset is included. CSP forbids connect and form-action; only same-origin script/style/assets are permitted.

Reproduce from the accompanying source package root, in a fresh process with Django and beautifulsoup4 installed (the generator is source-only, not part of this static sample):

    python scripts/generate_navigation_lab.py --output generated-navigation-lab

The base files show Chinese/English theme text and dark/light/auto styling. Two additional Chinese custom-brand files load only seven CSS token overrides (teal palette, .9 density, .95 spacing and10px radius). Favorites and common models are real theme navigation controls with an explicit synthetic storage scope; the badge3 comes from three synthetic Product rows and the scoped demo hook. App/model names remain those supplied by the host demo, which includes Chinese catalog names; theme gettext does not override host-model labels. Use native summary focus plus Space/Enter in a real browser to verify keyboard behavior. DOM tests alone are not full browser/accessibility certification.
